ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde trust & safety for manual review; preserve GPS trace, timeline and chat; route rider to RydeHELP reporting path (and 995 / driver's commercial motor insurance if any injury); append driver's statement to the driver's conduct file for human assessment.
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety (rider alleges speeding, hard braking, overtaking on the shoulder) and the driver's statement contains abuse/intimidation language toward the rider ("The rider is stupid"). Per SAFE-1, no automated ruling is issued; escalate to a human reviewer with the factual summary: trip T-2048 NUS→Raffles Place, RydeX fixed fare S$24.76 (base 3.90 + distance 15.10 + time 4.29 + platform 1.47, no tolls/waiting/cancellation fees), 16 min 5 s actual vs 16.5 min estimate, thinned GPS shows in-trip speeds of roughly 36–44.6 km/h with no sample above 50 km/h, fair weather, no LTA incidents, AYE/CTE links at speed band 4. Human review should weigh the full 5 s GPS trace, any telematics/vehicle data and any prior driver conduct records, and advise the rider of the RydeHELP reporting path (plus 995 / driver's commercial motor insurance if injury occurred).
